content: Constraint supplement for config AI: Keep this task small and authoritative. Produce the single M1 API/CLI/demo contract that downstream tasks must follow: no broad product redesign, no long narrative report, no implementation code. Use only T-007 and T-013 as authoritative inputs. Do not treat T024-T040 as usable assets. Acceptance must include exact forward/reverse demo inputs, expected output JSON shape, no-hit/error behavior, and pass/fail criteria.
